_note: Patch notes for the What's new card (ui/whats_new.gd), newest first. `version` matches application/config/version in project.godot: the card opens by itself once when the newest version here is one the player hasn't seen. Voice and rules: docs/WRITING.md. Short lines, no trailing full stop, one silly beat at most.

entries.title: The big wobble update
notes: Music! The game finally hums along while you bonk people
Goals: daily, weekly and lifetime coin goals, plus a streak bonus for your first win each day. Free coins, no catch
The Walldrobe only shows what you own. Everything else lives in the Shop, including a new Class tab
Secret classes: Boo, Champ and Rampage unlock as you play, win and K.O. Peek in the Walldrobe to see what each one wants
Got knocked flying? Tap RECOVER for a boing burst and wobble back into the fight
The setup wizard is sorted into Classic, Team and Special games, with little drawn icons and a Moving floor switch
New modes: Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, Sudden Death and Chaos. Chaos is exactly what it sounds like
Host your own room, with Godot-only modes when everyone's on the app. If the host leaves, someone else takes over and the match goes on
Build mode: make your own arena out of blocks, then play it with bots. Plus Lava Pillars, where the floor is (still) lava
Bigger buttons on small phones, and a Text and button size option in Settings
Hits feel crunchier: particles, trails, squash and stretch, a tiny freeze on big hits and some screen shake. Turn the shake off in Settings if your tummy says so
Accounts with cloud saves, a kill cam for your best K.O.s, and a fresh coat of paint on the skies, shadows and materials

entries.title: Hello, wobblers
notes: The first app build! Every arena, every weapon and the bots that live in them came over from the web game
Wobbly ragdoll legs, knockdowns and get-ups. Falling over is a feature
Touch controls built for thumbs: Fire, Jump, Melee (tap to shove, hold to kick), plus Dash or Reload when you need them
Play with web friends: join rooms hosted in the browser and fight side by side
Arenas that wobble, tilt, quake and drift. Pick Random if you like surprises
